leader.name: Milo
leader.title: Grass-type Gym Leader
win_messages: The soil of Turffield grew a stronger team today!
Ha! My grass just kept on growing back!
lose_messages: You uprooted my whole strategy. Well done!
That was a grand battle. The Gym Challenge suits you.

leader.name: Nessa
leader.title: Water-type Gym Leader
win_messages: The tide always comes in. You got swept away!
You'll need a better forecast than that to beat me.
lose_messages: Well! You broke through my wave. Impressive.
You've earned this. Go take the whole Gym Challenge.

leader.name: Sonia
leader.title: Electric-type Gym Leader
win_messages: My research says you need more training!
Yamper's still got more spark than your whole team!
lose_messages: Brilliant! You've given me plenty of new data.
Take the badge — Leon would have loved that battle.

leader.name: Kabu
leader.title: Fire-type Gym Leader
win_messages: My flames burn hotter than your resolve!
Train harder. Fire rewards only the dedicated.
lose_messages: Splendid! You have snuffed out my fire.
Your spirit burns brighter than mine today.

leader.name: Opal
leader.title: Bug-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Not pink enough, and not strong enough either!
My bugs have been crawling this forest far longer than you, dear.
lose_messages: Ohhh? You have a lovely shade of talent about you.
Take the badge, darling. You have earned an old woman’s respect.

leader.name: Klara
leader.title: Poison-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Teehee! Did my poison sting a little?
You should have stayed at the Dojo, sweetie.
lose_messages: Ugh! Fine, you win, you win!
Don't let this go to your head — I'll be back for a rematch.

leader.name: Avery
leader.title: Psychic-type Gym Leader
win_messages: My mind reads yours, and it says you are outmatched!
The Dojo taught me focus. You clearly skipped that lesson.
lose_messages: Impossible! My psychic power should not falter!
Very well. Your strength of mind exceeds mine today.

leader.name: Gordie
leader.title: Rock-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Rock solid! That's what my mum would call a landslide.
You cracked, kid. My stones didn't.
lose_messages: Blimey! You chipped right through my defence.
Nice climbing. That badge is yours, fair and square.

leader.name: Oleana
leader.title: Flying-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Macro Cosmos does not tolerate inefficiency. You are dismissed.
The Chairman expects results. This was not one.
lose_messages: ...I see. My schedule will have to accommodate this defeat.
Your performance was flawless. The badge is yours.

leader.name: Bea
leader.title: Fighting-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Your form was sloppy. Karate has no room for that.
Not enough. Come back when your body obeys your will.
lose_messages: ...I have been beaten. My training was not enough.
A clean victory. I acknowledge your strength.

leader.name: Melony
leader.title: Ice-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Aww, did the cold get to you, dear? Come back warmer.
Mummy knows best — and my ice knows better.
lose_messages: My, my! You melted right through me.
Well done, love. Gordie could learn a thing or two from that.

leader.name: Bede
leader.title: Fairy-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Naturally. I am the one chosen to be Champion.
Was that truly your best? How disappointing.
lose_messages: Impossible... I was supposed to be the strongest.
Hmph. Fine. You battled well. Take the badge.

leader.name: Gloria
leader.title: Normal-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Sorry! My Wooloo lot are tougher than they look.
That was a proper scrap, but the win is mine!
lose_messages: Wow! You battle like a Champion in the making.
The badge is yours — go on, take on the rest of Galar!

leader.name: Allister
leader.title: Ghost-type Gym Leader
win_messages: ...The spirits are not finished with you yet.
...You should not have looked behind my mask.
lose_messages: ...Ah. You saw through the fear. Thank you.
...The badge. Please take it, and go quietly.

leader.name: Piers
leader.title: Dark-type Gym Leader
win_messages: That's how we do it in Spikemuth. Loud and rough.
No encore for you, mate.
lose_messages: Heh. You've got a real punk spirit in you.
Take the badge. That was a proper gig.

leader.name: Rose
leader.title: Steel-type Gym Leader
win_messages: This is the future of Galar, and you are not part of it.
An unlimited supply of energy — and of Steel. You cannot outlast me.
lose_messages: So this is the strength of a true challenger. Remarkable.
Take the badge. Galar’s future may be brighter than I feared.

leader.name: Victor
leader.title: Ground-type Gym Leader
win_messages: The Wild Area is my turf. You never stood a chance out here.
Come back when the ground stops shaking under you!
lose_messages: Blimey, what a battle! You are the real deal.
The badge is yours. See you at the Champion Cup!

leader.name: Raihan
leader.title: Dragon-type Gym Leader
win_messages: Hahaha! Not even close, challenger! Train and come again!
The strongest Gym Leader stays undefeated!
lose_messages: Now THAT was a battle! You're my new rival!
Beaten in my own stadium! Go take the Champion next!
